text: I had a good experience at Smile Works Dental Clinic from start to finish. Trained in Frankfurt, Germany and he does quality work above European standards in my experience and experience. I had a front crown done that now looks spectacular a back crown and also an extraction. The extraction was complex to say the least and he persevered throughout, wjere a UK dentist would have sent for surgery. All the staff here are helpful and lovely people. Despite being a complex extraction there was little to no pain. He was been perfecting his craft since 1990 and is obvious in the work he has been doing for the last 35 years and the results overall. Thank you 😊

I applied to the clinic for the removal of my lower wisdom tooth. The staff is very friendly and speaks English. They took an X-ray and provided an approximate cost. Since there was no available time when I arrived, they suggested I come back later so the doctor could assess the situation and give me the exact cost of the removal. The doctor turned out to be a pleasant man; he examined me and asked when I was ready to have the tooth removed—now or later. Since the doctor was free, he began the extraction immediately. The entire process lasted about an hour; it was incredibly scary, and at times I was shaking, but there was no pain. I have a fear of dentists and the sound of the drill =))) After the appointment, they gave me a lot of medication and instructed me to return in 10 days to have the stitches removed. Today is the second day, and the wound hardly hurts. I am taking painkillers and believe everything will heal quickly. Thanks to the staff for handling everything neatly and relatively quickly. Lower wisdom teeth are dreadful. The procedure is certainly not cheap, but I decided to have the tooth removed because it started to break and hurt. All together, including X-rays, injections, and medications, the total cost came to over 6,000 baht, which is quite expensive, but they saved me from a problem that had been bothering me for more than a month. Thank you!

I had a tooth extracted today. I asked the dentist how long it would take, and they said 40 minutes, with 5 minutes for the anesthetic to work. But the dentist only took 3 minutes to extract it! I was surprised, but overall it was okay. It was a molar extraction and cost 1250 baht. I think it looks good. Good job!

Affordable and good, I highly recommend it! I had a molar extracted and paid 1500 baht myself, without social security insurance. The dentist was very gentle and quick, taking less than 5 minutes. Before I knew it, the dentist said, "It's done." And the anesthetic was instant; it numbed my mouth immediately. I really like the quick service.
